title: HyperCLOVA X Technical Report
findings: The paper does not provide findings specifically isolated to religion. The results are aggregated across all social categories of the BBQ and KoBBQ benchmarks. The general finding on social bias was that all models show lower accuracy in ambiguous contexts than in disambiguated contexts, and that HyperCLOVA X models performed strongly in Korean context bias tests (KoBBQ), exhibiting the highest accuracy and low diff-bias scores.
